propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py, and supporting classifiers) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed all consumers: differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes, _run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch, and reconcile_helpers.route_inbound_probe.
An earlier operator ruling on bug 3b5f prohibits using the port to restore same-pass issue re-creation, eliminating its original purpose and making it safe to delete as pure dead code.

The port must be deleted rather than re-homed to binding_walk because re-homing would re-cross ADR-0028 ownership boundaries and create vocabulary incompatibilities (ProbeBranch lacks confirmed-404 branch and conflates deletion with MOVE).

Deletion is behavior-neutral: the outbound probe leaf (_apply_outbound_probe, (outbound, probe) dispatch arm, MutationKind.probe) remains live and untouched; deletion detection stays outbound in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.

The orphaned resolved_statuses config keys and DC transport plumbing are deferred to a follow-up ticket (549c-032f-6cb0-4258) as a user-visible surface change requiring separate deprecate-vs-remove decision.
